payload._note: Kelly Services (KELYA) is a staffing/workforce solutions company. The 10-K discloses that in 2023, approximately 55% of total company revenue came from the largest 100 customers, and the largest single customer accounted for approximately 6% of total revenue. No specific customer names are disclosed. Under 'Government Contracts,' the filing states that while they conduct business under various federal, state, and local government contracts, no single government contract represents more than 3% of total revenue. Additionally, no single customer represented more than 10% of consolidated revenues. The business model is primarily staffing (temporary, permanent placement) and outcome-based services, which tend to be recurring but can also be project-based depending on customer engagement type. Given the staffing nature, revenue can fluctuate with economic cycles and customer demand rather than being purely subscription-based recurring.
